facts.statement: Free Realms ran Halloween content in October 2009, with more costumes, gear, decorations and quests promised between the post and the 31st.
facts.quote: Free Realms has a lot of great stuff planned between now and the 31st.

article_summaries.title: Halloween Around the Corner!
article_summaries.summary: A freerealms.com news post announcing Halloween 2009 content: the first seasonal costumes went on sale in the Station Cash marketplace, including a limited edition Wolfman costume that the post says will not return once sold out. It promises more costumes, gear, decorations and quests through the month, ending October 31.
